x:c:DCM-dcp-shadrach-roundy>c:DCM-dre124.label: bishopric, if he will receive it
x:c:DCM-dcp-shadrach-roundy>c:DCM-dre124.claim: D&C 124:141 names Shadrach Roundy with the bishopric group, conditionally ("if he will receive it").
x:c:DCM-dcp-shadrach-roundy>c:DCM-dre124.scope: Conditional assignment only; no acceptance, installation, tenure or succession; verse 141 only, not the 141–142 span.
x:c:DCM-dcp-shadrach-roundy>c:DCM-dre124.basis: Shared verse 141 names Roundy with the bishopric and qualifies his participation.

x:c:DCM-dcp-simonds-ryder>c:DCM-dcp-hema.label: receives the charge of
x:c:DCM-dcp-simonds-ryder>c:DCM-dcp-hema.claim: D&C 52:37 takes what had been bestowed on Heman Basset and places it on Simonds Ryder.
x:c:DCM-dcp-simonds-ryder>c:DCM-dcp-hema.scope: The expressly transferred charge only; no named office, general succession, kinship or identity.
x:c:DCM-dcp-simonds-ryder>c:DCM-dcp-hema.basis: Shared verse 37 supports the existing Ryder → Basset direction.

x:c:DCM-dcp-peter-whitmer-jr>c:DCM-dre03.claim: D&C 30:5–7 assigns Peter Whitmer Jr. to accompany Oliver Cowdery.
x:c:DCM-dcp-peter-whitmer-jr>c:DCM-dre03.scope: Companion assignment only; "brother" is not biological kinship; no route completion or missing stop inferred.
x:c:DCM-dcp-peter-whitmer-jr>c:DCM-dre03.basis: Shared verses 5–7 carry the assignment; full names come from the section heading, held as separate support.

support.purpose: identity: resolves the full names Peter Whitmer Jr. and Oliver Cowdery
support.claim: The D&C 30 section heading names Peter Whitmer Jr. as a recipient of the revelation.

x:c:DCM-dcp-william-law>c:DCM-dre124e-pr.label: counselor in the Presidency
x:c:DCM-dcp-william-law>c:DCM-dre124e-pr.claim: D&C 124:126 names William Law as a counselor in the Presidency.
x:c:DCM-dcp-william-law>c:DCM-dre124e-pr.scope: Verse 126 only, not the broader 91–97 overlap; no succession or identity with Hyrum Smith.
x:c:DCM-dcp-william-law>c:DCM-dre124e-pr.basis: Shared verse 126 expressly names Law as counselor.

x:c:BMV-186-sermon-compare-matthew-5>c:N.label: compare Matthew 5
x:c:BMV-186-sermon-compare-matthew-5>c:N.claim: 3 Nephi 12:1–12 and Matthew 5:1–12 present the beatitudes in the same order; the discourses are compared.
x:c:BMV-186-sermon-compare-matthew-5>c:N.scope: Comparison/context only: not identical quotation, the same event or place; wording, audience and setting differ; direction is navigational, not causal.
x:c:BMV-186-sermon-compare-matthew-5>c:N.basis: Independently paired bodies of both texts; the shared Matthew citation alone does not prove a parallel.

x:c:BMV-052-isaiah-11-righteous-judge>c:.label: compare Isaiah 11, in Nephi’s prophecy
x:c:BMV-052-isaiah-11-righteous-judge>c:.claim: 2 Nephi 30:9, 11–15 parallels Isaiah 11:4–9 (30:9 ~ 11:4; 30:11–15 ~ 11:5–9) within Nephi’s prophecy.
x:c:BMV-052-isaiah-11-righteous-judge>c:.scope: Only the Isaiah 11 component of the composite target; verse 10 excluded; no harmonized wording; not 2 Nephi 21.
x:c:BMV-052-isaiah-11-righteous-judge>c:.basis: Independently paired passages; Nephi’s framing is 30:1–3, 8, 10, 16–18.

x:c:DCM-dr09-smith-family>c:DCM-dcp-jose.claim: The D&C 4 historical heading names the recipient as the Prophet’s father, Joseph Smith Sr.
x:c:DCM-dr09-smith-family>c:DCM-dcp-jose.scope: This context/identity binding only, not every family-card assertion; Sr. stays distinct from Jr. and Joseph F. Smith; heading is its own component.
x:c:DCM-dr09-smith-family>c:DCM-dcp-jose.basis: Shared editorial section heading of D&C 4.

x:c:fm-person-christian-whitmer>c:FM05.claim: Christian Whitmer is a named signatory of the Testimony of Eight Witnesses.
x:c:fm-person-christian-whitmer>c:FM05.scope: Printed testimonial attribution only; not verification of the narrated event, testing, date, venue or kinship; document bofm/eight, not chapter 0.
x:c:fm-person-christian-whitmer>c:FM05.basis: Shared document: declaration paragraphs and the signatory list.

x:c:BMV-080-suffering-servant>c:OTM-c04-.label: Isaiah 53, quoted by Abinadi
x:c:BMV-080-suffering-servant>c:OTM-c04-.claim: Mosiah 14:1–12 represents Isaiah 53:1–12 as quoted by Abinadi (Mosiah 14:1 attributes it to Isaiah).
x:c:BMV-080-suffering-servant>c:OTM-c04-.scope: Represented literary quotation with variants, not byte-identical; Isaiah 53 only, not the target’s Isaiah 9/11; no witnessed events or fulfilment.
x:c:BMV-080-suffering-servant>c:OTM-c04-.basis: Independently paired passages; Abinadi continuity comes from Mosiah 13, held as separate support.

support.claim: Mosiah 13:1–6, 33–35 places the quotation inside Abinadi’s discourse.

x:c:BMV-020-babylon-quotation>c:OTM-baby.label: quoted from Isaiah
x:c:BMV-020-babylon-quotation>c:OTM-baby.claim: 1 Nephi 20:1–22 (esp. 20:20) parallels Isaiah 48:1–22 (esp. 48:20); 1 Nephi 19:23–24 frames the quotation.
x:c:BMV-020-babylon-quotation>c:OTM-baby.scope: DEFERRED UNCHANGED: the destination cites Isaiah 13:1, Jeremiah 51:59–64 and Ezekiel 17:12 (Babylon context), not the quoted passage; meaning of the edge must be distinguished first. No Lehite visit.
x:c:BMV-020-babylon-quotation>c:OTM-baby.basis: Recorded for completeness; no acceptance is recommended.

x:c:BMV-039-judah-damascus-samaria>c:OTM.label: same crisis, quoted
x:c:BMV-039-judah-damascus-samaria>c:OTM.claim: 2 Nephi 17:1–9 and Isaiah 7:1–9 name the same participants, attack and centres: the same crisis referent.
x:c:BMV-039-judah-damascus-samaria>c:OTM.scope: Same crisis referent only, not record equality; not the Immanuel sign (verses 10–14); no dates transferred; no Nephite geography.
x:c:BMV-039-judah-damascus-samaria>c:OTM.basis: Independently paired passages, not shared containment.

x:c:DCM-dr09-smith-family>c:DCM-dcp-hyru.claim: The D&C 11 historical heading identifies Hyrum Smith as the Prophet’s brother.
x:c:DCM-dr09-smith-family>c:DCM-dcp-hyru.scope: This identity binding only; verse 1 alone does not identify Hyrum; no additional genealogy.
x:c:DCM-dr09-smith-family>c:DCM-dcp-hyru.basis: Both cards cite the D&C 11 heading (shared-heading component).
